        ORG #6F19
        DI
        LD HL,#5FFF:LD (#5CB2),HL
        LD SP,HL:INC SP
        LD HL,#3E00:PUSH HL
        LD HL,#1303:PUSH HL
        LD (#5C3D),SP
        LD HL,BASIC
        LD DE,#5D3B
        LD BC,EBASIC-BASIC
        LDIR
        EX DE,HL
        LD (#5C61),HL
        LD (#5C63),HL
        LD (#5C65),HL
        DEC HL:DEC HL
        LD (#5C59),HL
        DEC HL
        LD (#5C4B),HL
        LD (IY+14),7
        LD (IY+83),7
        LD (IY+48),8
        LD HL,EPROG
        LD DE,#5C26
        LD BC,EEPROG-EPROG
        LDIR
        LD A,#13:LD HL,#D200
        LD BC,#4800:CALL CLMEM
        LD A,#14:LD HL,#0000
        LD BC,#0000:CALL CLMEM
        LD A,#17:LD HL,#D000
        LD BC,#4000:CALL CLMEM
        LD A,#10:LD HL,#0000
        LD BC,#0000:CALL CLMEM
        EI:HALT:DI
        XOR A:OUT (#FE),A
        LD A,#10:LD HL,#5B00
        LD BC,#6C00
        CALL CLMEM

        LD A,(#5D19);-3
        AND 3;-2
        LD (DRIVE),A;-3
        CALL EXPCOLS;-3
        JP START

CLMEM   POP DE
        LD SP,HL
        LD L,C
        LD H,A
        LD A,B
        LD BC,#7FFD:OUT (C),H
        LD B,A
        LD H,L
.32     PUSH HL
        DJNZ $-32
        LD SP,(#5C3D)
        EX DE,HL:JP (HL)

EPROG   LD BC,#7FFD
        LD A,#14
        OUT (C),A
        JP #C000
        JR EPROG
EEPROG

BASIC   DB 0,5,#0B,0,#F9,#C0,#B0,#22
        DB "23600",#22,#0D,#80,#0D,#80
EBASIC

        ORG #8000
INST    LD IY,#5C3A:IM 1:EI
        LD HL,(#5C3D):LD BC,#5FFC
        OR A:SBC HL,BC:JR Z,INST1
        RST 8:DB 3
INST1   ADD HL,BC:LD SP,HL
        HALT:DI:XOR A:OUT (#FE),A
        LD HL,SWAP+#4000:LD DE,#5000
        LD BC,SWAP3-SWAP
        LDIR
        LD HL,START
        PUSH HL
        LD DE,#1000
        JP #5000

RUN     LD HL,(ASTART)
        LD A,H:OR L:RET Z
        CALL DEINST
        LD HL,23600:PUSH HL
        LD HL,(ASTART)
        JR QUIT0

DEBUG   CALL DEINST
        LD HL,#DB00
        LD D,#17
        JR QUIT1

QUIT    CALL DEINST
        LD HL,#FFCF:PUSH HL
        LD HL,0:ADD HL,SP
QUIT0   LD D,#10
QUIT1   PUSH HL:LD E,#01
        JP #5000

DEINST  POP HL:EXX
        LD IY,#5C3A:IM 1
        EI:HALT:DI
        LD SP,#5FFC
        LD HL,SWAP:LD DE,#5000
        LD BC,SWAP3-SWAP
        LDIR
        EXX:JP (HL)

;D-BANK
;E = 1 - CL_STS_SCR + CL_DCR_BANK

SWAP    LD HL,0:ADD HL,SP:EXX
        LD A,#14:LD BC,#7FFD:OUT (C),A
        LD HL,#5800:LD DE,#5801
        LD BC,#02FF:LD (HL),L
        LDIR
        LD SP,#5706
        LD HL,#C956:PUSH HL
        LD HL,#00C2:PUSH HL
        LD HL,#25DD:PUSH HL
        LD HL,#02A8
        LD DE,#ED1A
        LD B,#40
SWAP1   PUSH HL:PUSH DE:DJNZ SWAP1
        LD H,#E9:PUSH HL:INC SP
        LD HL,#DE10:PUSH HL
        LD HL,#D5D5
        LD BC,#1000
SWAP1A  PUSH HL:DJNZ SWAP1A
        PUSH BC
        LD HL,#11E1:PUSH HL
        LD C,B:LD HX,B
        LD HL,#FFFF:LD DE,#BFFF
        CALL #5600
        LD BC,#7FFD
        PUSH BC
        LD A,#13:OUT (C),A
        LD DE,#CFFF
        PUSH DE
        LD HL,#7FFF
        LD BC,#8000:LD HX,#40
        CALL #5600
        POP DE:POP BC
        LD A,#17:OUT (C),A
        LD BC,#7000:LD HX,#40
        CALL #5600
        EXX:RR E:EXX
        JR NC,SWAP1B
        LD SP,#DB00:LD B,108
        CALL #55D9
        LD A,BDCR
        LD BC,#7FFD:OUT (C),A
        LD SP,#0000:LD B,0
        CALL #55D9
SWAP1B  LD SP,#5000:LD B,64
        CALL #55D9
        LD HL,#2758
        EXX
        LD BC,#7FFD:OUT (C),D
        LD SP,HL
        DEC HL:DEC HL:DEC HL
        EX DE,HL
        LD HL,SWAP3-SWAP+#4FFF
        LD BC,SWAP3-SWAP2
        LDDR
        INC DE:PUSH DE
        LD HL,#5000:LD DE,#5001
        LD BC,#0800:LD (HL),L
        LD A,7
        LD IY,#5C3A
        RET

SWAP2   LDIR
        LD (HL),A
        LD BC,#02FF
        LDIR
        EI
        RET
SWAP3

GERR    LD IY,#5C3A:IM 1
        LD A,4:OUT (#FE),A
        LD SP,(GUSP)
        EI
        RST 8:DB 2

;EXPAND COLORS
EXPCOLS LD DE,CLSTORE
        LD HL,LECOL
        LD A,(DE)
        AND 7;LECOL
        LD (HL),A
        LD A,(DE)
        XOR (HL):INC HL;MNCOL
.3      RRCA
        AND 7
        LD (HL),A:INC HL,DE
        LD A,(DE)
        AND #0F
        CALL EXPCOL
        INC HL
        LD A,(DE)
        AND #F0
.4      RRCA
EXPCOL  BIT 3,A
        JR Z,$+4
        XOR #48
        LD (HL),A
        RET

;**************************************

ASSEMB  DI
        LD (ASUSP),SP
        CALL ASM4
        CALL INITLBL
        XOR A:CALL ASPASS
        JR NZ,ASM1
        LD A,1:CALL ASPASS
        JR NZ,ASM1
        LD HL,(ASTART)
        LD A,H:OR L
        JR NZ,ASM0
        LD H,#80:LD (ASTART),HL
ASM0    LD IX,VAR
        JP RETHINK

ASM1    LD A,H
        OR A
        LD A,6
        JR NZ,ASM2
        LD A,2
ASM2    LD HL,ASMES1+7
        LD BC,ERRS
        CALL DL49
        LD (HL),0
        LD HL,ASMES1
        LD DE,(MLINE')+6
        LD A,2:LD C,3
        CALL PRSTRI
ASM3A   CALL ASKEY
ASM3    LD SP,(ASUSP)
        CALL ASM4
        LD IX,VAR
        CALL CLWIND
        JR ASM0

ASM4    LD HL,#FFFF
        LD (MINADR),HL
        INC HL
        LD (MAXADR),HL
        LD (ASTART),HL
        RET

ASERR   EX AF,AF
        LD A,(PASS):CP #FE
        JP Z,CALC2
        EX AF,AF
        PUSH HL:PUSH BC:PUSH DE
        EXX
        PUSH HL:PUSH BC:PUSH DE
        PUSH IX:PUSH IY
        LD (ASCDERR),A
        LD HL,ASSTAT:SET 6,(HL)
        LD HL,(ERRS)
        LD A,H:OR L
        INC HL:LD (ERRS),HL
        JR NZ,ASER2
ASER1   LD (ERRSCR),A
        LD DE,#0100
        LD BC,(HGT')+32
        LD A,ASMCOL
        CALL WIND
ASER2   LD A,(ERRSCR):CP HGT
        JR NZ,ASER6
        CALL ASKEY
        JR NC,ASM3
        XOR A
        JR ASER1

ASKEY   LD B,0
ASER3   EI:HALT:DI
        PUSH BC
        CALL ASER4
        POP BC
        INC B
        XOR A:IN A,(#FE)
        CPL:AND #1F
        JR Z,ASER3
        LD A,#7F:IN A,(#FE):RRA
        LD B,#FF
ASER4   PUSH AF
        LD HL,ASMES2
        BIT 2,B:JR Z,ASER5
        LD HL,ASMES2+5
ASER5   LD DE,(MLINE')+20
        LD A,2:LD C,1
        CALL PRSTRI
        POP AF
        RET

ASER6   LD BC,ASNLN
        LD HL,BUFF32
        LD A,6
        PUSH HL
        CALL DL49
        LD (HL),":":INC HL
        LD A,(ASSTAT)
        AND #0F:ADD A,#30
        LD (HL),A:INC HL
        LD (HL),0
        LD HL,ERRSCR
        INC (HL)
        LD D,(HL)
        POP HL
        LD E,1:LD A,E:LD C,2
        PUSH DE
        CALL PRSTRI
        LD A,(ASCDERR):LD E,A
        LD HL,ASMER1
        CALL FINDSTR
        POP DE:PUSH DE
        LD E,7
        LD A,1:LD C,6
        CALL PRSTRI
        POP DE
        LD A,(INCLMD)
        OR A:JR Z,ASERE
        XOR A:LD (BUFFN+8),A
        LD HL,BUFFN
        LD E,25
        LD A,1,C,2
        CALL PRSTRI
ASERE   POP IY:POP IX
        POP DE:POP BC:POP HL
        EXX
        POP DE:POP BC:POP HL
        RET

ASPASS  LD (PASS),A
        ADD A,#30:LD (ASMES0+5),A
        LD HL,ASMES0:CALL PUTMSG
        XOR A:LD (INCLMD),A
        LD (ASREPT),A
        LD H,A:LD L,A
        LD (ASNLN),HL
        LD (ERRS),HL
        LD H,#80
        LD (ASADR),HL
        LD (ASDEST),HL
        LD HL,BEGBTX+1
        LD IX,ASBUFC
        CALL ASLINE
        LD HL,(ERRS)
        LD A,H:OR L
        RET

WRC     LD DE,(ASDEST)
        LD HL,(MINADR)
        OR A:SBC HL,DE
        JR C,WRC2
        LD (MINADR),DE
        LD A,D:CP #60:JR C,WRC7
WRC2    PUSH DE
        EX DE,HL
        ADD HL,BC
        LD (ASDEST),HL
        DEC HL
        LD A,H:OR A:JR Z,WRC7
        EX DE,HL
        LD HL,(MAXADR)
        OR A:SBC HL,DE
        JR NC,WRC3
        LD (MAXADR),DE
WRC3    POP DE
        LD HL,ASBUFC

;DE-ADR OF VIRTUAL MEMORY
;HL-ADR
;B=#00 (HL)>VIRTUAL
;B=#80 VIRTUAL>(HL)
;C-LEN

WRC0    PUSH IX
        LD IX,WRCTBL
WRC4    LD A,D
        OR A:JR Z,WRC4A
        DEC A
        CP (IX):JR NC,WRC6
        LD A,(IX+1):CALL SBANKA
WRC4A   XOR A:EX AF,AF
        LD A,D:CP (IX)
        JR NZ,WRC5
        LD A,E:ADD A,C:JR NC,WRC5
        EX AF,AF
        LD A,E:NEG:LD C,A
WRC5    LD A,D:ADD A,(IX+2):LD D,A
        BIT 7,B:JR Z,WRC5A
        RES 7,B
        EX DE,HL:LDIR:EX DE,HL
        SET 7,B
        JR WRC5B

WRC5A   LDIR
WRC5B   EX AF,AF
        LD C,A
        LD D,(IX):INC D:LD E,B
WRC6    INC IX:INC IX:INC IX
        LD A,B:AND #7F:OR C
        JR NZ,WRC4
        POP IX
        JR SBTXT

WRC7    LD A,13:CALL ASERR
        JP ASM3A

SBDCR   PUSH AF
        LD A,BDCR
        JR SBTXT1

SBTXT   PUSH AF
        LD A,BTXT
SBTXT1  CALL SBANKA
        POP AF
        RET

SBANKA  PUSH BC
        LD BC,#7FFD:OUT (C),A
        POP BC
        RET

INITLBL LD BC,#7FFD
        PUSH BC
        LD A,ASBLBL:OUT (C),A
        LD HL,ABLABEL*256
        LD B,L:LD C,L
;LOOP
        INC L:LD (HL),C:INC HL
        DJNZ $-3
        LD (AELBL),HL
        POP BC
        LD A,ASBTXT:OUT (C),A
        RET

WRCODE  LD A,LX:OR A:RET Z
        PUSH HL
        PUSH DE
        PUSH BC
        LD C,A:LD B,0
        LD HL,(ASADR)
        ADD HL,BC
        LD (ASADR),HL
        LD A,(PASS):OR A
        CALL NZ,WRC
        LD LX,B
        POP BC
        POP DE
        POP HL
        RET

MINCL   PUSH IX
        LD A,(INCLMD):OR A
        LD A,15:JR NZ,INCL1
        CALL SELNAME
        JR NC,INCL2
        LD A,7
INCL1   CALL ASERR
        POP IX
        RET

INCL2   PUSH DE
        LD DE,BUFFN
        CALL FILEFL
        POP DE
        JR NC,INCL2A
        CP 2:JP NZ,ASM3
        LD A,14:JR INCL1

INCL2A  POP IX
        PUSH DE
        LD E,(HL):INC HL
        LD D,(HL):INC HL
        INC HL
        LD C,(HL):INC HL
        LD B,(HL)
        LD (SECTR),BC
        LD HL,(ASNLN):PUSH HL
        LD HL,(ASARPT):PUSH HL
        LD A,(ASSTAT):LD L,A
        LD A,(ASREPT):LD H,A
        PUSH HL
        XOR A:LD (ASREPT),A
        LD L,A:LD H,A
        LD (ASNLN),HL
        LD A,#C9:LD (INCLMD),A
        LD BC,0:CALL INCL4
        XOR A:LD (INCLMD),A
        POP HL
        LD A,H:LD (ASREPT),A
        LD A,L:LD (ASSTAT),A
        POP HL:LD (ASARPT),HL
        POP HL:LD (ASNLN),HL
        POP DE:LD A,(DE)
        CP #8C:JR Z,MINCL
        CP #DC:JR Z,MINCL
        RET

; HL-ADDR, DE-DISK, BC-MEM

INCL4   LD A,B:OR A:JR NZ,INCL9
        LD A,C:CP #40:JR NC,INCL9
        LD A,D:OR E:JR NZ,INCL5
        LD A,B:OR C:JR NZ,INCL9
        RET

INCL5   PUSH DE
        LD DE,BUF1024
        LD A,B:OR C
        JR Z,$+4:LDIR
        LD HL,BUF1024+#0700
        OR A:SBC HL,DE:LD L,0
        POP BC:PUSH BC
        OR A:SBC HL,BC:ADD HL,BC
        JR NC,INCL7
        LD B,H:LD C,L
INCL7   POP HL
        OR A:SBC HL,BC
        PUSH HL
        LD H,D:LD L,E
        ADD HL,BC
        PUSH HL
        EX DE,HL
        LD DE,(SECTR)
        LD A,C:OR A
        JR Z,$+3:INC B
        PUSH IX
        LD C,5:CALL DOS
        JP C,ASM3
        POP IX
        POP HL
        LD BC,BUF1024
        OR A:SBC HL,BC
        LD B,H:LD C,L
        LD HL,BUF1024
        POP DE
INCL9   PUSH DE
        PUSH BC
        PUSH HL
        CALL ASLINE
        LD D,H:LD E,L
        POP BC
        OR A:SBC HL,BC
        LD B,H:LD C,L
        POP HL
        OR A:SBC HL,BC
        JP C,GERR
        LD B,H:LD C,L
        EX DE,HL
        POP DE
        JR INCL4

MINCB   CALL SELNAME
        JR NC,INCB2
        LD A,7
INCB1   CALL ASERR
INCB1A  LD IX,ASBUFC
        RET

INCB2   LD BC,(ASDEST)
        LD HL,(MINADR)
        OR A:SBC HL,BC
        JR C,INCB2B
        LD (MINADR),BC
INCB2B  LD A,B:CP #60
        LD A,13:JR C,INCB1
        PUSH DE
        LD HL,0
        PUSH BC
        PUSH BC
        OR A:SBC HL,BC
        LD B,H:LD C,L
        LD DE,BUFFN
        POP HL
        LD A,(PASS)
        CALL VRLOAD
        CALL SBTXT
        POP HL
        POP DE
        JR C,INCB4
        PUSH DE
        ADD HL,BC
        LD (ASDEST),HL
        DEC HL
        EX DE,HL
        LD HL,(MAXADR)
        OR A:SBC HL,DE
        JR NC,INCB2A
        LD (MAXADR),DE
INCB2A  POP DE
        LD HL,(ASADR)
        ADD HL,BC
        LD (ASADR),HL
INCB3   LD A,(DE)
        CP #8C:JR Z,MINCB
        CP #DC:JR Z,MINCB
        JR INCB1A

INCB4   CP 2:JP C,ASM3
        JR Z,INCB5
        LD A,13:CALL ASERR
        JP ASM3A

INCB5   LD A,14:CALL ASERR
        JR INCB3

SELNAME LD HL,BUFFN
        LD BC,#0820
SLN1    LD (HL),C:INC L:DJNZ SLN1
        LD (HL),"C"
        LD L,BUFFN\256
        LD A,(DE)
        CP #8C:JR Z,SLN2
        CP #DC
        SCF:RET NZ
SLN4    INC DE
        LD B,9
SLN5    LD A,(DE):INC DE
        CP #20:JR C,SLN6
        LD (HL),A:INC L
SLN5A   DJNZ SLN5
SLN5B   JP ASPA1

SLN6    OR A:RET Z
SLN7    LD (HL),#20:INC L
        DEC A:JR Z,SLN5A
        DJNZ SLN7
        JR SLN5B

SLN2    INC DE
        LD A,(DE):INC DE
        LD C,A
        LD A,(DE):INC DE
        OR A:JR Z,SLN3
        LD (HL),A:INC L
SLN3    LD (HL),C
        OR A:RET

SAVEOBJ LD HL,(MAXADR)
        LD DE,(MINADR)
        OR A:SBC HL,DE
        RET C:INC HL
        LD (SVOB1+1),HL
        LD HL,SVOBJM
        CALL DSINP
        LD HL,(MINADR)
SVOB1   LD BC,0
        LD DE,ONAME
        CALL VRSAVE
        JR NC,SVOB2
        CP 4:CALL Z,SAVE0
SVOB2   CALL SBTXT
        JP RETHINK

;VIRTUAL SAVE
;HL-ADDR   NC - OK
;BC-LEN  C A=0-ERR
;DE-NAME C A=1-BREAK
;        C A=4-NO_SPACE

VRSAVE  PUSH HL:PUSH DE:PUSH BC
        LD A,#82;OBJ SAVE MODE
        CALL FILEKL
        LD HL,(CATBF+#08E1)
        LD (SECTR),HL
        POP BC:POP DE:POP HL
        JR NC,VRSV0
        CP 2:SCF:RET NZ
VRSV0   LD A,(CATBF+#08E4)
        CP #80:JR Z,VRSV1
        LD A,(CATBF+#08E6)
        OR A:JR NZ,VRSV
        LD A,(CATBF+#08E5)
        CP B:JR C,VRSV1
        JR NZ,VRSV
        LD A,C:OR A
        JR Z,VRSV
VRSV1   JP FLSV2A

VRSV    PUSH HL:PUSH DE:PUSH BC
        LD DE,WRITE
        CALL RWVR
        POP BC:POP DE:POP HL
        RET C
        JP FLSV4

;VIRTUAL LOAD
;DE-NAME HL-ADDR  NC  -OK, BC-LEN
;BC-TOP SIZE     C A=0-ERR
;A=1  LOAD         A=1-BREAK
;A=0 CHECK LEN     A=2-NO_FILE
;                  A=3-TOO_BIG

VRLOAD  PUSH AF
        PUSH HL:PUSH BC
        CALL FILEFL
        POP BC:POP DE
        EX AF,AF:POP AF:EX AF,AF
        RET C
        LD A,C:CP (HL)
        LD C,(HL):INC HL
        LD A,B:SBC A,(HL)
        LD A,3:RET C
        LD B,(HL):INC HL
        EX AF,AF
        OR A:RET Z
        INC HL
        LD A,(HL):INC HL
        LD H,(HL)
        LD L,A
        LD (SECTR),HL
        EX DE,HL
        PUSH BC
        LD DE,READ
        CALL RWVR
        POP BC
        RET

;HL,ADR DE,LEN > C=ERR NC=OK
WRITE   LD A,0;LAST SEC TAIL
        OR A:JR Z,WR1
        CALL WR4
        PUSH DE
        LD A,(WRITE+1):LD E,A
        LD D,BUF1024/256
        CALL RD4
        LD (WRITE+1),A
        PUSH HL
        LD DE,(SECTR)
        DEC E:BIT 7,E:JR Z,WR0
        LD E,15:DEC D
WR0     LD C,6
        CALL WR3
        POP HL:POP DE
        RET C
        LD A,D:OR E
        RET Z
WR1     LD C,6:CALL RWMC:RET C
        LD A,E:OR A:RET Z
        LD (WRITE+1),A
        LD C,A
        LD DE,BUF1024
        CALL RD4
        LD C,6
WR2     LD DE,(SECTR)
WR3     LD B,1
        LD HL,BUF1024
        CALL DOS
        RET
WR4     NEG
        INC D:DEC D:JR NZ,WR5
        CP E
        JR C,$+3:LD A,E
WR5     LD C,A:XOR A:LD B,A
        EX DE,HL
        SBC HL,BC
        EX DE,HL
        RET

;HL,ADR DE,LEN > NC=OK C=ERR
READ    LD A,0;SEC TAIL
        OR A:JR Z,RD2
        CALL WR4
        PUSH DE
        LD D,BUF1024/256
        LD A,(READ+1):LD E,A
        EX DE,HL
        CALL RD4
        LD (READ+1),A
        EX DE,HL
        POP DE
RD2     LD C,5:CALL RWMC:RET C
        LD A,E:OR A:RET Z
        LD (READ+1),A
        PUSH HL:PUSH DE
        LD C,5:CALL WR2
        POP BC:POP DE
        RET C
RD3     LD HL,BUF1024
RD4     XOR A:LD B,A:LDIR
        RET

RWMC    LD A,D:OR A:RET Z
        PUSH HL:PUSH DE
        LD B,D:LD DE,(SECTR)
        CALL DOS
;В DE ОТКОРРЕКТИРОВАННОЕ ЗНАЧЕНИЕ
;АДРЕСА-МОЖНО ВЫБРОСИТЬ PUSH/POP HL,
;ADD H,D И ЗАМЕНИТЬ НА EX DE,HL
;ПРИРОСТ 7 БАЙТ!
        POP DE:POP HL
        RET C
        LD A,H:ADD A,D:LD H,A
        XOR A
        RET

;READWRITE VIRT MEM
;HL-MEMADR BC-LEN DE-R/W PROC
RWVR    LD (RWVR1+1),DE
        INC DE:XOR A:LD (DE),A
RWVR0   LD (RWVR2+1),HL

VACON   EX DE,HL
        PUSH BC
        LD HL,WRCTBL+1
        LD A,D
        SUB 1:JR C,VAC1
        DEC HL
VAC0    CP (HL):JR NC,VAC2
VAC1    PUSH HL
        LD H,(HL)
        INC H:LD L,0
        OR A:SBC HL,DE
        LD C,L:LD B,H
        POP HL
        INC HL:LD A,(HL)
        CALL SBANKA
        INC HL:LD A,(HL)
        ADD A,D:LD D,A
        POP HL
        OR A:SBC HL,BC
        JR NC,VAC3
        ADD HL,BC
        LD C,L:LD B,H
        LD HL,0
VAC3    EX DE,HL
;HL-ADR BC-LEN DE-TAIL

        PUSH DE:PUSH BC
        LD D,B:LD E,C
RWVR1   CALL 0
        POP DE:POP BC
        JR C,RWWRE
RWVR2   LD HL,0
        ADD HL,DE
        LD A,B:OR C:JR NZ,RWVR0
RWWRE   JP SBTXT

VAC2    INC HL:INC HL:INC HL
        JR VAC0

;**************************************

        INCL "ED"
        INCL "XED"
        INCL "DPC"

WRCTBL  DB #5F,#10,#00
        DB #6F,#17,#60
        DB #7F,#13,#50
        DB #BF,#14,#40
        DB #FF,#10,#00

ASMES0  DB "PASS X",0
ASMES1  DB "ERRORS XXXXX",0
ASMES2  DB "KEY ",0,"    ",0

ASMER1  DB "Label not defined",0
        DB "Label already defined",0
        DB "No label space",0
        DB "Too many operands",0
        DB "Syntax error",0
        DB "Operand excepted",0
        DB "Invalid operand",0
        DB "Number too big",0
        DB "Offset error",0
        DB "Expression error",0
        DB "Overflow",0
        DB "Invalid EQU",0
        DB "Out of memory",0
NOFILEM DB "No file",0
        DB "Illegal INCL",0

VAR     ;WILL BE SAVED
KEYSTAT DB 0
PX      DB 0
PY      DB 1
BEGBSCR DB 0
